record.body:
## Description

Restructure adaptive-artifacts into an installable package with pyproject.toml and console-script entry point, keeping thin compatibility shims at historical paths. Waits on the approved AA packaging amendment.

## Approach

1. After amendment approval, in ~/adaptive-artifacts: add root pyproject.toml (hatchling or setuptools) with project name adaptive-artifacts and [project.scripts] adaptive-artifacts → package main.
2. Move tools/runtime (+ CLI from tools/artifacts.py) into src/adaptive_artifacts/ (or equivalent import package); fix internal imports.
3. Replace bin/adaptive-artifacts and tools/artifacts.py with thin shims that invoke the package entry (no sys.path reopening of tools/runtime).
4. Keep plugin layouts pointing at bin/adaptive-artifacts. Run AA's own tests if present; prove shims with --help plus one store-touching command on a temp store.
record.subject: aa-installable-package
